title: Hukum Internasional (International Law)
description: Information regarding Public and Private International Law / Informasi mengenai Hukum Internasional Publik dan Privat.

sections.content_id: Hukum yang mengatur hubungan antar negara dan subjek hukum internasional lainnya. Sumber utamanya termasuk perjanjian internasional (treaties), kebiasaan internasional, dan prinsip-prinsip hukum umum.
sections.content_en: Law governing relations between nations and other subjects of international law. Primary sources include international treaties, customary international law, and general principles of law.

sections.content_id: Mengatur hubungan hukum keperdataan yang melewati batas negara (lintas batas). Fokus utama pada yurisdiksi, pilihan hukum (choice of law), dan pengakuan putusan asing.
sections.content_en: Governs private law relationships that cross national borders. Primary focus on jurisdiction, choice of law, and recognition of foreign judgments.

sections.content_id: Di Indonesia, pengesahan perjanjian internasional diatur dalam UU No. 24 Tahun 2000. Beberapa perjanjian memerlukan persetujuan DPR, sementara yang lain cukup dengan Peraturan Presiden.
sections.content_en: In Indonesia, ratification of international treaties is governed by Law No. 24 of 2000. Some treaties require parliamentary approval, while others only need a Presidential Regulation.
